name: Ubersuggest
description: Ubersuggest lets agents read keyword ideas, search volume, domain traffic, backlinks, and site audit data. Access is read-only, and each user signs in to their own Ubersuggest account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find keyword ideas for project management software with their search volume.
What are the top pages of a competitor's domain by estimated traffic?
Summarize the backlinks of my site and the strongest referring domains.

apps.name: Ubersuggest
apps.description: Keyword, traffic, backlink, and site audit data, over NP Digital's MCP server with browser sign-in.
